about:
Electronic Specialty Company was founded in 1947 as a locally owned West Virginia corporation in Dunbar, just outside Charleston. Over the decades it has grown into one of the largest electronic systems integrators in the Mid‑Atlantic region, operating from its headquarters on Dunbar Avenue.

The company specializes in the design, installation, and ongoing service of low‑voltage life‑safety and critical‑communication systems. Its portfolio spans fire alarm, security, CCTV, nurse call, school communications, professional sound, access control, acoustical treatment, and parking equipment. A staff of 54 includes 27 factory‑trained and certified technicians who handle system review, budgeting, CAD layout, commissioning, inspection, monitoring, and repair with online documentation.

Electronic Specialty serves commercial, industrial, institutional, and government clients. Concrete markets include hospitals, schools, prisons, chemical plants, and building contractors across the Mid‑Atlantic. The firm works directly with end‑users and design professionals to develop code‑compliant layouts and performance specifications.

The company emphasizes a drug‑free workplace and a substance‑detection policy for all employees. Its stated mission is to be the employer, solutions provider, and partner of choice, offering a single comprehensive source for life‑safety products and certified technical support from initial layout through long‑term maintenance.
